_about: Mother Teresa Rd (Zoo-Narengi Rd) features from Hatigarh Chariali to past the mandir, from Google Street View (imagery Mar 2026, walked 2026-10-15). x = local metres east (same frame as geo.json). Lateral positions are given as a side (N/S/median) plus an offset rule, because the Street View camera coordinates on this stretch are offset ~8-13 m north of the true road (geo.json edges match Google satellite, checked by the lead), so absolute pano y values would misplace things. 'verified' = seen on a pano, x within ~5 m; 'estimated' = inferred, interpolated or not visible. Owner: streets session (mainroad.js, streetlife.js, streets.js read this file).
